rules.sentence: It is essential to base the diagnosis of Meniere disease on the criteria published and mentioned in this article to warrant a uniform diagnosis, especially in the presence of different international approaches to diagnosing patients with vertigo.
Meningioma is classified into three grades, according to the World Health Organization.
However, symptomatic patients usually require surgery to lower the risk of recurrence and severity of the disease.
Since most patients with meningioma are asymptomatic, the management is usually done with close observation and follow-up with serial imaging.
